create.name: Laura Day
create.bio:
Laura Day is a New York author and teacher who has spent around forty years treating intuition as a practical skill that anyone can train, not a rare gift. Her first big success, Practical Intuition, became a New York Times bestseller and set the tone for her later work: books written as hands-on workshops, where the reader sets a goal, carries out exercises and then checks what happened. Further titles followed, among them How to Rule the World from Your Couch, The Circle and Welcome to Your Crisis, and in 2025 she published The Prism, a seven-step programme for coming to terms with the past and shaping the future.

Alongside her writing she has worked for decades as an intuitive consultant to companies and individuals, with a particular interest in forecasting and weighing options, and she prefers to teach organisations to build these skills in their own staff. She takes a grounded line on spiritual practice, favouring methods that improve ordinary daily life over ones that withdraw from it. Her yearly Boot Camp, a certificate training held online, gathers students into a long-running community of practice, and she also offers one-to-one intuitive coaching by phone, regular Instagram broadcasts and short teaching videos on YouTube.

books.title: The Prism: Seven Steps to Heal Your Past and Transform Your Future
books.author: Laura Day
books.description: A seven-step programme, refined with students over about ten years, for making peace with old patterns and building the future you want. It draws on her own difficult family history.

books.title: Practical Intuition
books.author: Laura Day
books.description: Her best-known book, a workbook of exercises for noticing and testing intuitive impressions and using them in work, relationships and everyday choices.

books.title: The Circle: How the Power of a Single Wish Can Change Your Life
books.author: Laura Day
books.description: A guided programme built around one heartfelt wish, with daily practices for clarifying what you want and moving towards it.

books.title: How to Rule the World from Your Couch
books.author: Laura Day
books.description: Exercises for using intuition to influence situations and people at a distance, aimed at practical goals in career and relationships.

courses.title: Practical Intuition Certificate Training 2027 (Boot Camp)
courses.description: Her yearly certificate training in intuition and manifestation, taught live over four afternoons (New York time) in September and November 2027, with a WhatsApp group so the cohort can keep practising together afterwards.
